main_subject.detail: A complete [OBJECT] silhouette constructed entirely from bold playful lettering that follows its curves and contours.
main_subject.style: Clean vector illustration, graphic poster design

items: Center: [OBJECT] silhouette filled edge-to-edge with adaptive lettering.

No extra props beyond minimal shape-defining details.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp vector edges, no realistic shading, strong color contrast

prompt_instructions: Ensure letters fill the whole silhouette while staying readable in major areas.
Do not use an unapproved logo as the silhouette.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a typographic illustration shaped like a {OBJECT}, where the text itself forms the shape - bold and playful lettering style that fills the entire silhouette - letters adapt fluidly to the curves and contours of the object - vibrant and contrasting color palette that fits the theme - background is solid and enhances the focus on the main shape - vector-style, clean, high resolution, poster format, 1:1 aspect ratio.
prompt.negative_prompt: photorealism, empty silhouette, unreadable text, complex background, muddy palette, low resolution, watermark, signature
